scenes.text: It's tax season again. Salary slips, Form sixteen, bank statements, rent receipts... and a deadline that will not wait.
scenes.caption: Tax season again. Salary slips, Form 16, bank statements, rent receipts... and a deadline that won't wait.

scenes.text: Meet Muse. Your personal tax assistant, who walks with you through every single step.
scenes.caption: Meet Muse. Your personal tax assistant, with you at every step.

scenes.text: First, I build your personal checklist. Form sixteen, A I S, interest certificates, investment proofs. Just snap or upload, and I sort everything for you.
scenes.caption: First, your personal checklist. Snap or upload, and Muse sorts everything.

scenes.text: Next, we plan. I compare the old and new tax regimes, find every deduction you qualify for, and show you exactly how much you save.
scenes.caption: Next, we plan. Old vs new regime, every deduction, exactly how much you save.

scenes.text: You see your refund before you file. No guesswork. No surprises.
scenes.caption: See your refund before you file. No guesswork. No surprises.

scenes.text: Finally, one tap to file your I T R. I pre-fill it, double check it, and e-verify it. Done.
scenes.caption: One tap to file your ITR. Pre-filled, double-checked, e-verified. Done.

scenes.text: Muse. From documents, to done. Your taxes, handled.
scenes.caption: Muse. From documents to done.
